coverage.reason: Repair two reproduced shared-window faults: Gear Box theme classes leaked after close and hid Daily Login navigation, and Profile Escape/outside-pointer handlers dismissed the Profile under a child dialog. Open Daily Login with only its own view classes, retire Box classes during normal cleanup, and let open/targeted child dialogs own dismissal. Browser regressions fail on the prior code and cover real Gear Box close/reopen and in-place Reports-to-Daily transitions, all three reward tabs, desktop/landscape/fullscreen/touch/keyboard geometry, topmost-only Escape over Daily/Chat/flag confirmation, mouse/touch Chat close, uncovered Profile dismissal, queued close events and existing report/activity lifecycle. Box validation covers close/reopen, in-flight requests and late results; optional UI checks cover first loads, stylesheet failure/retry and shared view ownership. Daily rewards/login sequencing validators protect the unchanged reward and auto-open flow; production build and asset budgets verify delivery. Artwork checks in the affected reward layout suite are brought in line with the already-approved labeled HUD images and existing uncaptioned window illustrations. Client lifecycle only; no reward rules, API, backend or data changes, so emulator suites are not applicable.
